AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-backend#671 @ c75002c9eef3ebc4dd7c41d537fc38028635e4dc — VERDICT: APPROVE
A/B/C = 0/0/1

Job AUD-OPUS-T12-117 (agent 117). Tier T4 (money path). Trials T1 (model + rules), base main `b644198b90bb9ab1dc62a78794e12cf09f8ace7c`, 17 files, +2,291 / -0. Every changed line was read: both migration up/down pairs, schema, deletion manifest, RLS, `trial-usage.service.ts`, `trial-checkout-capability.ts`, `trial-rules.ts`, `trial-copy.ts`, `trial-view.ts`, diagnostics, the `ci.yml` live-suite addition and all specs.

### Evidence reuse decision

None reused. This lens never approved #656 or any earlier T1 head (last verdict: REQUEST CHANGES 0/1/3 at `a6a2b589`, https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/671#issuecomment-5976130575), so the current head received a full fresh audit. Fix round 7 is merge-only and was checked, not assumed: `git diff b644198b c75002c9` is byte-identical to `git diff d23fa317 1efac91e` (fix round 6 tree against its own base), 17 files.

### Prior findings at this head

- **B-671-1 closed.** `src/packages/trials/trial-usage.service.ts:248-309`: after a skipped insert and after a lost released-row takeover, `markStarted` re-reads by purchase and enters `startOwned` (`:318-347`, bounded three-attempt compare-and-set) before it may answer `conflict`; another purchase is still refused. Reasoned under READ COMMITTED for the insert/insert, insert/takeover and takeover/takeover races. Failing-before https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37174151877, passing-after https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37174355443. At this exact head, `mwb-3-live-tests` (job 111369404524 in https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37179640430) executed `test/b-trials-usage-concurrency.live.spec.ts` against Postgres: 8 suites / 66 tests passed, none skipped.
- **C-671-1 closed** (`trial-view.ts:98-102`: no `trial_ends_at` reads `none`). **C-671-2 closed** (live suite wired and executed). **C-671-3 closed** (`trial-copy.ts:10-39`, minor digits from `Intl`).

### Checked and sound

Migrations `20270228000000` / `20270313000000` are additive with defaults or nullable columns and real `down.sql`; the `CoachPackage` CHECK mirrors the service rule (0..30, recurring, paid, no one-time companion). New tables ENABLE + FORCE RLS, service-role all, self-select only, anon restrictive deny plus REVOKE; `PackageTrialConflict` is server-only and holds no user id. Every new direct user-id column has a deletion-manifest entry. Nothing outside `src/packages/trials` imports the new code, so T1 is inert on main until T2/T3. `20270228000000` sorts before production's applied `20270301*`; harmless under `prisma migrate deploy` (applies unapplied migrations regardless of order).

### C-671-4 — a trial that never started can read "The trial is over"

- **File:line:** `src/packages/trials/trial-view.ts:24-25` and `:98-103`. The view returns `ended` for any non-trialing purchase with `trial_ends_at` set, on the stated premise that `trial_ends_at` is written only when a trial really starts. T3 (#673 @ `4ebf2a43`, `src/checkout/checkout-webhook-handler.service.ts:921`, `applyTrialState`) writes `trial_ends_at = sub.trial_end` on every subscription event, including a trialing subscription with no card (no access, trial never started) and a purchase that lost the one-trial race.
- **Counterexample (probe, red as expected):** `purchaseTrialView({ status: 'canceled', entitlement_active: false, trial_days: 7, trial_ends_at: <past>, card_on_file: false })` returns `state: 'ended'` for an attempt that never got access. https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37183472931 (spec `test/audit-opus-t12-117-672.spec.ts`, on #672 @ `6ce54002`, whose `trial-view.ts` is identical to this head).
- **Consequence:** copy only (a client is told a trial ended that never began); no access or money effect. Optional.
- **Minimal fix rule:** `ended` only when the trial is known to have started: pass the ledger fact (`PackageTrialUsage` started for this purchase, e.g. a `trialStarted` context flag from `TrialUsageService.hasStarted`) into `purchaseTrialView` and read `none` otherwise; or have T3 write `trial_ends_at` only when the trial starts. Either way, correct the comment at `:98-101`. The T3 audit owns the composed check.

### CI

All 11 required checks green at `c75002c9` (https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37179640430); `build-and-test` ran `b-trials-one-trial-rule` and `b-trials-t1-fix-round-6` (728 suites passed).

### Landing limits

Approval of T1 as a piece, not release acceptance. The stack lands as one (T1 -> T2 -> T3), deploys only with mobile #338 and after the owner enables the Stripe event `customer.subscription.trial_will_end`. The recurring/trials composition with #680 (one reservation ledger, release on expiry, capability registration, server-side trial parameters) remains owed by whichever stack lands second (C-656-1, outside this diff).

No candidate-branch edits, merges, workflow dispatches, provider or production actions. Probes ran only on `audit/AUD-OPUS-T12-117/672-probes` through the CI lane.
